title: SSB Constable GD Sports Quota 2026 - 404 Posts, 10th Pass, No Written Exam, Apply by June 7
author: Ash K.
summary: Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) is recruiting 404 Constable (GD) under Sports Quota. 10th pass with state/national level sports achievements eligible. No written exam - selection on sports merit. Apply online by June 7, 2026 at recruitment.ssb.gov.in. Salary ₹21,700-69,100.
body: Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) under the Ministry of Home Affairs has released notification for 404 Constable (General Duty) posts under Sports Quota. This is a rare opportunity where selection is based entirely on sports achievements - no written exam.

DetailInformation
Total Posts404 Constable (GD)
Recruitment TypeSports Quota (Male + Female)
Apply StartMay 9, 2026
Last DateJune 7, 2026
Eligibility10th pass + sports achievements (last 2 years)
Age Limit18-23 years (relaxation for SC/ST/OBC)
SelectionSports achievement evaluation + Field Trials + PST + Medical
Written ExamNo written exam
SalaryLevel 3: ₹21,700-69,100 + allowances
Application Fee₹100 (Gen/OBC/EWS), Free for SC/ST/Ex-SM/Women
Sports DisciplinesArchery, Athletics, Boxing, Basketball, Football, Hockey, Judo, Kabaddi, Karate, Taekwondo, Volleyball, Wrestling, Wushu
Apply Atrecruitment.ssb.gov.in

Who can apply: Male and female sportspersons who have represented their state, university, or India at recognized national/international sports competitions in the last 2 years. You must have valid sports certificates from recognized sports federations.

Selection process: No written examination. Selection is based on (1) evaluation of sports achievements and certificates, (2) Field Trials in your sport, (3) Physical Standard Test (height and weight), and (4) Medical examination. Final merit is prepared sport-wise.

Sports disciplines: Archery, Athletics (track and field), Boxing, Basketball, Football, Hockey, Judo, Kabaddi, Karate, Taekwondo, Volleyball, Wrestling, and Wushu. Each sport has separate vacancy allocation.

How to apply: Visit recruitment.ssb.gov.in → Register → Fill application form → Upload photo, signature, educational certificates, and sports achievement certificates → Pay ₹100 fee (if applicable) → Submit before June 7.

Career in SSB: Constable GD in SSB is a Group C central government post with Level 3 pay (₹21,700-69,100). SSB guards India's borders with Nepal and Bhutan. Benefits include government accommodation, medical facilities, CSD canteen, LTC, and pension under NPS.
For other defence career opportunities, check our NDA exam guide. For age relaxation details in central govt jobs, see our age relaxation rules guide.

faqs.question: Is there a written exam for SSB Sports Quota 2026?
faqs.answer: No. There is no written examination. Selection is based entirely on sports achievement evaluation, field trials, physical standard test, and medical examination.

faqs.question: What sports are eligible for SSB Sports Quota?
faqs.answer: Archery, Athletics, Boxing, Basketball, Football, Hockey, Judo, Kabaddi, Karate, Taekwondo, Volleyball, Wrestling, and Wushu. You must have represented your state/university/India in these sports.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for SSB Constable Sports Quota?
faqs.answer: 18-23 years as on June 7, 2026. Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years.

faqs.question: Can women apply for SSB Sports Quota 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both male and female sportspersons can apply. Women are also exempt from the application fee.

faqs.question: What is the salary for SSB Constable GD?
faqs.answer: Pay Level 3 with salary range ₹21,700-69,100 per month plus DA, HRA, free accommodation, medical, CSD canteen, and other CAPF benefits.

callout.heading: No Written Exam - Sports Merit Only
callout.content: SSB Sports Quota is one of the rare central government recruitments with NO written exam. If you've represented your state or university in any of the 13 listed sports in the last 2 years, apply now at recruitment.ssb.gov.in before June 7.
